-- Tables added for PL_Cab_Data_Ingestion (run log + taxi zone staging).
IF OBJECT_ID('operation.PipelineRunLog') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE operation.PipelineRunLog
(
    PipelineName   varchar(200)  NOT NULL,
    PipelineRunId  varchar(100)  NOT NULL,
    ActivityName   varchar(200)  NULL,
    RunStatus      varchar(20)   NOT NULL,
    RunMessage     varchar(4000) NULL,
    LoggedAtUtc    datetime2     NOT NULL
)
WITH (DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN, HEAP);
GO

-- Target of PL_Spark_Test Copy activity (DS_Processed_Sales_By_City_Product -> DS_SQL_DynamicTable).
IF OBJECT_ID('dw.SalesByCityProduct') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE dw.SalesByCityProduct
(
    City         varchar(100) NULL,
    Product      varchar(100) NULL,
    TotalAmount  bigint       NULL
)
WITH (DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE, CLUSTERED INDEX (City, Product));
GO

IF OBJECT_ID('stage.TaxiZoneLookup') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE stage.TaxiZoneLookup
(
    LocationID    varchar(8000),
    Borough       varchar(8000),
    Zone          varchar(8000),
    service_zone  varchar(8000)
)
WITH (DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN, HEAP);
GO
